description:
Operating Area: Sardinia, Corsica, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera and the Italian Riviera

Sunreef 70 Sail ANKAWER VI is a very premium, brand-new sailing catamaran representing the highest standards of the Sunreef Yachts shipyard — globally recognized for building some of the most refined luxury catamarans on the market. Combining elegant contemporary design, exceptional build quality, and expansive living spaces, the Sunreef 70 delivers a highly polished charter experience for guests who prioritize comfort, style, and privacy.
Designed with Mediterranean cruising in mind, ANKAWER VI offers an outstanding balance between luxury sailing and relaxed onboard living. The yacht features extensive exterior areas, including a spacious aft cockpit ideal for al fresco dining, a large foredeck designed for sunbathing and relaxation, and an impressive flybridge with multiple lounge areas and panoramic sea views. The catamaran’s wide beam and advanced hull design provide remarkable stability both underway and at anchor, creating a smooth and comfortable experience throughout the charter.
What truly sets ANKAWER VI apart is the overall onboard atmosphere. The yacht is operated by a professional full crew delivering a refined, guest-focused level of service, making her an excellent option for families, couples, and clients looking for a highly personalized and seamless charter experience. The combination of premium hospitality, elegant design, and spacious layout creates a feeling much closer to a private floating villa than a traditional yacht charter.
Built in 2025, ANKAWER VI offers accommodation in 4 spacious en-suite cabins, comprising a generous master suite and three beautifully appointed double cabins. The yacht is ideally configured for 8 guests in standard cabin accommodation, while flexible sleeping arrangements allow for a total overnight capacity of up to 10 guests when required.
The interiors are bright, modern, and thoughtfully designed to maximize both comfort and functionality. Large windows bring abundant natural light throughout the yacht, creating a calm, sophisticated onboard atmosphere, while the spacious layout ensures privacy and comfort for families, couples, and groups of friends alike. 
The yacht is also exceptionally well equipped for relaxed Mediterranean cruising, featuring kayaks, paddleboards, snorkeling equipment, electric bicycles, and a Highfield tender for comfortable shore access and water activities.
ANKAWER VI is a particularly strong option for guests looking for a high-end catamaran charter in Sardinia, Corsica, the French Riviera, or the Amalfi Coast — especially for those who value premium quality, elegant service, generous living space, and a more refined, boutique-style onboard experience.

crew.name: Tomasz Jaworski
crew.bio:
Polish 
Languages spoken: English, Polish

Tomasz Jaworski is a professional yacht captain specializing in premium crewed charters, with extensive experience across the Mediterranean, Caribbean, Atlantic routes, and European coastal waters. With a strong technical and engineering background, he combines excellent seamanship with a proactive and hands-on approach to yacht maintenance and onboard operations.
Holding an RYA Yachtmaster Offshore Commercial Endorsement together with multiple sailing and motorboat certifications, Tomasz has captained and operated a wide range of catamarans and monohulls up to 80ft, including Sunreef, Moon, FP Saba, and Catana yachts. His experience includes both luxury charter operations and international deliveries across demanding cruising areas.
Known for his calm leadership, reliability, and guest-focused mindset, Tomasz is confident managing crew and delivering smooth, safe, and highly personalized charter experiences. His engineering skills, strong organizational approach, and attention to detail make him particularly well suited to premium catamaran operations.
Friendly, approachable, and highly professional, Tomasz creates a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere onboard while ensuring high operational standards throughout every charter aboard ANKAWER VI.

crew.name: Krzysztof Lewicki
crew.bio:
Polish
Languages spoken: English, Polish

Krzysztof is an experienced yacht captain with over 15 years of offshore sailing experience and more than a decade in professional skippering roles. His background combines strong technical seamanship with a highly refined, guest-oriented approach to luxury charter operations.
Having worked extensively across various cruising environments, Krzysztof brings a deep understanding of yacht management, navigation, safety procedures, and hands-on vessel maintenance. He is known for his calm leadership style, reliability under pressure, and ability to create a smooth and relaxed onboard atmosphere for both guests and crew.
What particularly distinguishes Krzysztof is his people-focused approach, shaped by a strong interest in psychology and interpersonal dynamics. He intuitively adapts to different guest profiles and charter styles whether guests are looking for a social, engaging sailing experience or complete privacy and quiet relaxation onboard.
Professional, discreet, and highly attentive to detail, Krzysztof believes that exceptional charters are built on the combination of a well-maintained yacht, thoughtful hospitality, and a calm, confident captain presence.
Friendly, approachable, and highly organized, he creates a welcoming and safe environment onboard while maintaining high operational and service standards throughout every charter.

crew.name: Slayter Marc Streefkerk
crew.bio:
South Africa
Languages spoken: English

A motivated and hardworking deckhand with experience onboard private motor yachts, sailing catamarans, and classic sailing vessels across the Mediterranean and Caribbean. Reliable, adaptable, and hands-on, he brings strong operational support across all aspects of deck work, maintenance, and guest service.
His experience includes tender handling, mooring operations, washdowns, teak maintenance, sail handling, water sports support, and general yacht upkeep. Having also worked as a sole crew member onboard a private 24m catamaran during winter operations, he developed a broad understanding of vessel management, maintenance coordination, and day-to-day onboard responsibilities.
With additional experience in shipyard periods, electrical works, carpentry assistance, and engineering support, he is comfortable both in busy charter environments and maintenance-focused programs. Calm under pressure and eager to continue progressing within the industry, he brings a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and professional approach onboard.

crew.name: Kornelia Maj
crew.bio:
Polish
Languages spoken: English, Polish

Kornelia Maj is a dedicated and detail-oriented Stewardess with strong experience across luxury catamarans, crewed charters, and high-end hospitality environments in the Mediterranean and Caribbean. With several seasons in the yachting industry, she delivers warm, attentive guest service while maintaining impeccably organized and beautifully presented onboard interiors.
Her experience includes guest service, housekeeping, table styling, provisioning, bartending, event preparation, and day-to-day charter support aboard both private and charter yachts. Kornelia is particularly valued for her professionalism, calm efficiency, and ability to create a relaxed and welcoming onboard atmosphere tailored to each guest profile.
Known for her cheerful personality, adaptability, and strong hospitality mindset, she also brings additional skills in barista service, cocktail preparation, light cooking support, and creative presentation. Her combination of service expertise, positive energy, and genuine passion for life at sea makes her a valuable and versatile part of the onboard experience aboard ANKAWER VI.

crew.name: Marek Michalski
crew.bio:
Polish
Languages spoken: Polish, English, Russian, German

Marek Michalski is an experienced and versatile yacht chef with a strong background in luxury hospitality, fine dining, and international cruise operations across Europe and the Caribbean. With many years of experience leading professional kitchens both ashore and at sea, he combines refined culinary presentation with the flexibility and efficiency required in high-end charter environments.
Having worked across luxury cruises, boutique hotels, alpine resorts, and premium gastronomy concepts, Marek brings a broad international culinary perspective together with a strong guest-focused approach. His cuisine style combines elegant presentation, fresh Mediterranean influences, and modern international flavors, always adapted to guest preferences and dietary requirements.
Known for his calm professionalism, creativity, and strong organizational skills, Marek creates a relaxed and enjoyable onboard dining experience while maintaining high hospitality standards throughout every charter. In addition to his culinary expertise, he also holds yachting certifications including STCW and ENG1, giving him a solid understanding of onboard operations and life at sea aboard ANKAWER VI.
